schema_pilot.scope: event metadata and QuakeML pick-schema inspection only

comparators.causal_visibility_wrapper: Expose only samples available at each update, use each released model's documented window and threshold without target tuning, and publish a pick only when its inference window closes.
comparators.classical_baseline: Run the frozen recursive strong-motion baseline under the same 100 Hz causal input and event/continuous manifests.

domain_exposure_disclosure.cspp: No NC/NCSN event or continuous source appears in the sealed CSPP training protocols. CSPP training includes InstanceGM, K-NET, opened CWA 2020 events, and Southern California/other presumed non-event continuous windows.
domain_exposure_disclosure.eqtransformer: Report the provenance of the exact released checkpoint used; do not claim unseen-domain status without verification.
domain_exposure_disclosure.phasenet: The released PhaseNet model was trained with Northern California seismic data; NCSN is therefore external to CSPP but not an unseen domain for this comparator.

comparators.interpretation_boundary: These are released-model architecture and window comparisons, not matched retraining on the CSPP training set.
comparators.same_record_endpoint: Run released pretrained models on the same acquired records and report native full-record picking metrics.

continuous_cohort.adjudication: Review every multistation group and every single-station candidate when feasible. If the latter exceeds 500, review a frozen seeded sample of 500 plus all extreme-score candidates. Report unresolved cases separately; do not label them false alarms.
continuous_cohort.event_free_screen: Exclude dates with a cataloged M>=3.0 event within 200 km of any selected station; retain the screen manifest and catalog query.
continuous_cohort.selection: Deterministic availability-only station ranking and UTC-date sampling, frozen before waveform access.

cspp_execution.candidate_release: Release once at the close of the first packet satisfying the frozen candidate and event thresholds; estimate P time from only the current and previous packets and bounded recurrent state.

decision_chain_ablation.label: post-hoc mechanistic analysis
decision_chain_ablation.scope: frozen post-training rule ablation on identical score caches

event_cohort.manifest_rule: Freeze every requested event-station-channel unit from metadata before waveform access. Missing or unusable requests are retained in acquisition and QC accounting and are never replaced.
event_cohort.primary_reference_pick: Preferred-origin-associated manual reviewed P pick at the same station with positive arrival time weight.
event_cohort.secondary_reference_pick_sensitivity: All preferred-origin-associated manual reviewed P picks at the same station, irrespective of arrival weight.
event_cohort.station_order: ascending epicentral distance, then network, station, location, and channel code

network_confirmation.claim_boundary: Coincidence filtering is not event association, hypocenter location, or origin-time inversion.

primary_metrics: candidate availability delay median and 95th percentile
event_metrics.uncertainty: Wilson 95% intervals for binomial metrics and event-clustered bootstrap intervals for station-record summaries.

failure_policy: If the primary result is poor, retain it unchanged as the external test. Any later adaptation becomes a separately labeled development experiment with a new, untouched confirmation dataset.
next_boundary: Target-period metadata may be queried only after the acquisition tool verifies the SHA-256 of this protocol. Freeze the exact event, station, and continuous request manifests before downloading target waveforms.
objective: External-network evaluation of packet-level causal strong-motion P-wave candidate release without model, threshold, or rule changes.
prohibited_after_freeze: changing model weights, seeds, thresholds, packet size, or filters
selecting stations, events, or dates from model outputs
replacing unavailable event-station requests with easier records
suppressing failed acquisitions or quality exclusions
calling unresolved continuous candidates false alarms
using target results to revise the primary analysis

waveform_qc_and_preprocessing.accounting: Report metadata-eligible, successfully acquired, structurally valid, and model-scorable counts separately.
waveform_qc_and_preprocessing.gap_policy: Represent gaps explicitly; do not interpolate. Reset quality, normalization, and recurrent states at every invalid segment.
waveform_qc_and_preprocessing.model_input: Three-component acceleration in Z/N/E order, 0.5 s packets at 100 Hz, with PacketQualityGateV5 and causal EWMA normalization.
waveform_qc_and_preprocessing.post_access_exclusions: Only predeclared structural failures may be excluded from scored metrics; report every exclusion reason and denominator.
waveform_qc_and_preprocessing.response_conversion: Convert counts to acceleration using StationXML sensitivity only; do not perform acausal response deconvolution.
waveform_qc_and_preprocessing.sample_rate_policy: Keep native 100 Hz channels; decimate 200 Hz channels to 100 Hz with the frozen stateful 31-tap causal FIR.
